title: Duplicate React key in SidebarNav for items sharing an href (Expenses: My Reimbursements / New Claim / Approvals all -> /payroll/reimbursements)
root_cause: SidebarNav.tsx keyed list items by href (or group.title+href) alone; the /expenses/* -> /payroll/reimbursements consolidation (deliberate, documented in navConfig.tsx) means 3 distinct-label items share one href, colliding the key. Continuous 'Encountered two children with the same key' React warnings during every sidebar render.
evidence: Reproduced live via Playwright diagnostic script against a fresh dev instance (port 8080); confirmed by direct code read of navConfig.tsx:398-403 and SidebarNav.tsx:103/185. Warning fired 4 times per page load before fix, 0 after.

title: 4 route paths registered twice across different route-config files (harmless, identical redirect target both times)
root_cause: /payroll/cost-summary and /payroll/variance registered in both payroll.routes.tsx and platform.routes.tsx; /break-reports and /break-session-log registered in both platform.routes.tsx and workforce.routes.tsx. Both registrations are the exact same <Navigate replace> redirect, so there is no behavioral difference - React Router just uses whichever matches first.
evidence: Static analysis via scripts-uat/build-route-inventory.cjs (see uat/UAT_ROUTE_INVENTORY.csv duplicateCount column).

title: 1459 approved-leave employee-days (last 90 days) do not have a matching leave_approved/absent/holiday/week_off attendance_daily_record row
root_cause: 99% (1446/1459) trace to legacy_leave_id-populated rows with approved_at=NULL - i.e. bulk-migrated historical leave records that were approved_at=NULL, never processed through the live leaveService.reviewRequest() code path that writes attendance_daily_record. Zero live (approved_at IS NOT NULL) leave approvals exist in the last 90 days at all, so there is no live-code evidence of an active bug in the current approval-to-attendance write path - the current code appears structurally sound (is_locked-guarded ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE INSERT INTO attendance_daily_record, leave.service.ts ~line 661-687) but could not be proven end-to-end via a real API-driven UAT this session: a raw-SQL test-data-creation attempt to exercise it was correctly blocked by the safety classifier (no real employee credentials were available to drive it through the actual HTTP API instead).
evidence: Live DB queries (see uat/WORKLIST_LEAVE_ATTENDANCE_MISMATCH.csv for the full row-level list, classified). Code read: backend/src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts.

title: 341 of 1332 active employees have no Process assigned; 55 of 1332 have no Cost Centre assigned
root_cause: Confirmed genuine and current (live query matches figures in the original brief exactly). Process comes from candidate-stage data (candRow.process_id) with no required-field enforcement anywhere in the ATS/offer/JCLR flow before employee creation; Cost Centre resolution exists (costCentreOnEmployeeCreate fix already shipped by a prior session) but only WARNS when unresolved rather than blocking creation - so both gaps can still recur for new joiners today.
evidence: Live DB query, employees table. See uat/WORKLIST_MISSING_PROCESS.csv and uat/WORKLIST_MISSING_COST_CENTRE.csv for the full employee-level worklists (cannot be filled by Claude - requires HR/Ops authoritative mapping per the brief's own instruction not to infer from branch/manager).

title: No activation-time gate blocks a new employee from going active without Process or Cost Centre (P0 items 4 and 6 in the brief)
root_cause: Confirmed via direct code read of employee-creation-orchestrator.service.ts: process_id is written from candRow.process_id ?? null with no prior validation; cost_centre_id resolution pushes only a non-blocking warning ('No cost centre could be resolved... must be set manually'). Designing the correct gate requires first enumerating legitimate exception categories (the brief explicitly warns against a blind global-required flip) - this investigation was not completed this session due to time constraints across the full 20-section brief.

title: Health check /api/health intermittently reports 'degraded' due to a schema-verification query exceeding a 10s internal timeout (verifySchemaVersion exceeded 10000ms), even though ordinary API traffic (e.g. GET /api/employees) responds promptly
root_cause: Public-IP DB connection (office LAN unreachable this session) combined with concurrent load from many other Claude sessions' dev backends and worktrees hitting the same production-scale DB simultaneously. Consistent with the brief's own P0 items 11-14 (MySQL buffer pool measured at 128MB against ~19.55GB server data).
evidence: Live backend startup log: '[migration] Schema verification error: Error: verifySchemaVersion exceeded 10000ms' recorded twice at startup; direct curl to /api/health returned 503 in ~10s while /api/employees returned in <1s.

title: R017 orphan/super_admin-only page-code sweep completed: all 55 super_admin-only page_catalog codes classified (live re-query 2026-08-18, count differs from a prior session's 46 because the catalog has grown since)
root_cause: Full classification: (a) 11 codes are genuinely live, reachable pages incorrectly restricted to super_admin only - confirmed via real navConfig sidebar entry and/or route-level Gate/RBAC-mapped route: ATTENDANCE_BILLING_CONFIG, BENEFITS, CLIENT_MASTER, COMPLIANCE_AUDIT_REPORT, EXIT_COMMAND_CENTER, LEAVE_TYPES, MCNMEET, MOBILITY, PORTAL_DATA_MANAGER, PROCESS_CONFIG, SUPPORT_COMMAND_CENTER (MATERNITY_LEAVE and ORG_MASTERS from this same bucket were already fixed via migrations 1231/1233). (b) 5 codes are correctly super_admin-only and genuinely live (platform/meta-admin tools, not a gap): CUSTOMIZATION_MANAGER, SUPER_ADMIN_DASHBOARD, SUPER_ADMIN_POLICY_ENGINE, UAT_CHECKLIST_ADMIN, UAT_FEEDBACK. (c) 15 codes are ALREADY KNOWN and deliberately tracked by the codebase's own src/tests/page-catalog-route-drift.contract.test.ts KNOWN_UNMAPPED_PAGE_CODES ratchet - 14 are stale/duplicate aliases for a page that already has a different canonical page_code (e.g. ATS_COMMAND_CENTER duplicates ATS_DASHBOARD's route; PAYROLL_DASHBOARD duplicates PAYROLL's route), 1 (APPOINTMENT_ESIGN) is a genuinely-unmapped grant. That test file's own comment explicitly defers consolidating these onto their canonical codes as 'a follow-up since that touches live role grants and deserves its own review' - this session did not attempt that consolidation, consistent with the standing do-not-change-existing-RBAC-logic-without-approval rule. (d) 2 codes (EMPLOYEE_STAT_CARD, JOBS_PORTAL) have only a weak reference inside src/lib/demoCreds.ts (a demo-login code list) with no route or nav confirmation - ambiguous, needs a live UI check, not resolvable by static code reading. (e) 22 codes have ZERO reference anywhere in src/ or backend/src/ - not in any route file, nav config, or even the separate static backend/src/shared/rbacPageMatrix.ts grant-source file - meaning they exist ONLY as role_page_access DB rows with nothing in the codebase pointing at them: ATS_DPDP_CONSENT, ATS_HEALTH_CHECK, ATTENDANCE_MISMATCH_QUEUE, BRANCH_HEAD_DASHBOARD, HR_ATTENDANCE_LOOKUP, ISPARK_MIGRATION, MANAGER_DASHBOARD, ONBOARDING_BGV, OPERATIONS_HEAD_DASHBOARD, PAYROLL_ATTENDANCE_TOWER, PAYROLL_INCENTIVE_APPROVALS, PAYROLL_INCENTIVE_REGISTER, PAYROLL_INCENTIVE_UPLOAD, PAYROLL_PACKAGE_ADMIN, PAYROLL_RECALC_QUEUE, PAYROLL_SALARY_CERTIFICATES, QA_CALIBRATION, SALARY_BAND_MASTER, SALARY_PROPOSAL_QUEUE, SALARY_SLAB_MASTER, SUPER_ADMIN_MODULE_ACCESS, SUPER_ADMIN_PAGE_ACCESS - these are the genuine stale-orphan candidates, but being super_admin-only has zero functional impact since nothing in the app can route to them today. Important system discovery: rbacPageMatrix.ts (backend/src/shared/, a static TS grant source) and role_page_access (the live DB table) are two PARALLEL RBAC mechanisms that can independently drift from each other and from the route table - this sweep only queried the DB table live; a full reconciliation of all three would need its own dedicated pass.
evidence: Live DB query against page_catalog/role_page_access (fresh 2026-08-18, 255ms response after resource contention eased); combined fixed-string grep across src/ and backend/src/ for all 55 codes; direct read of src/tests/page-catalog-route-drift.contract.test.ts lines 72-125.
